description: Conflict analysis for vessel-repository-independence specification - examining interactions with other specifications

relatedSpecifications.name: complete-architecture-separation

differingScopes.vesselRepositoryIndependence: Repository-level separation, HTTP-only communication, deployment independence
differingScopes.completeArchitectureSeparation: Component-level separation (opencode/CLI/RPC), ML logic isolation, data flow boundaries

conflictAnalysis.reason: Both specifications enforce separation at different architectural layers. Vessel-independence operates at repository/deployment level (MiniBob, Activity API, Dashboard), while architecture-separation operates at component level (opencode, CLI, RPC API). These layers do not overlap or contradict.

relatedSpecifications.recommendation: KEEP BOTH - Specifications are complementary and reinforce each other

differingScopes.vesselRepositoryIndependence: No code imports, HTTP communication, deployment independence

conflictAnalysis.reason: Type preservation focuses on data schema consistency (ensuring ActivityTemplate, ExecutionRecord types match across vessels), while vessel-independence focuses on code-level decoupling. These are orthogonal concerns.

synergies: Type duplication (required by independence) benefits from preservation (ensures consistency)
HTTP API contracts (required by independence) validated by type preservation
